description: Baseline: terrain objects (tree/pine/house/rock/flower/boat/bush) placed via biome rules, shown in all view modes. 3D view: richer sky gradient with clouds, varied surface textures per biome and distance, depth fog, terrain objects as vertical elements. ISO view: objects with trunks, south-face column shading, varied surface glyphs. 2D views: objects shown as coloured glyphs.

Window maximised (155x60 vs 118x34). 3D view: sun with glow, stars, cloud banks (sin noise), rich cliff textures (█▓▒░ gradient), multi-row object sprites (5-row trees, 4-row houses near camera), depth-banded surface glyphs, perspective-correct foreground, wave patterns with foam. Water still dominates on archipelago terrain.

Layered atmosphere: 5-zone sky (zenith stars, cirrus wisps, cumulus banks, atmospheric haze, horizon glow), sun pillar effect, sun reflections on water with foam caps, richer wave patterns. All 5 render modes working, WASD+arrow movement preserved.
